A product name can appear because an answer is replacing that product. In a 22 September 2026 [ChatGPT answer about Housecall Pro alternatives](https://zenodo.org/records/22907695/files/answers-2026-09.jsonl?download=1), the opening put Jobber first and then asked why the buyer was “replacing Housecall Pro”. That observed role is not an endorsement of Housecall Pro, and it cannot underwrite a promise about a future recommendation.

## What we measured

description.new: No. An agency can guarantee the work and a test agreed before payment, not what an engine will say next.
description.old: Separate promised work from future answers: Housecall Pro was named in 108/150 dated answers, not a guaranteed outcome.
